name: Hazelwood Millworks Custom Carpentry & Woodworking
old_description: Looking to renovate your kitchen, bathroom, or another room? Hazelwood Millworks proudly specializes in custom cabinetry. Choose from Oak, Walnut, Ash, Maple, Cherry, and more to create a stunning statement piece. Cabinets alone can significantly elevate an outdated kitchen, providing not only a beautiful environment but also increased home value.
about:
Hazelwood Millworks operates from Hilliard, Ohio, serving the greater Columbus metropolitan area including suburbs such as Dublin, Upper Arlington, and Westerville. The company specializes in custom carpentry and woodworking, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork, handling projects from design through fabrication and installation. Capabilities include matching existing moldings and hand-carved ornate details, with services available for both new construction and renovation. The product range spans dining tables, coffee tables, chairs, bookshelves, vanities, and built-in features such as staircases, moldings, handrails, columns, and wainscoting.

The company serves residential and commercial customers across central Ohio, working directly with homeowners as well as partnering with interior designers, architects, and general contractors. Its commercial portfolio includes projects for small businesses, courtrooms, churches, and schools, and it bids on governmental work.

Hazelwood Millworks emphasizes ethically sourced lumber, often using previously fallen trees or reclaimed wood, and highlights its commitment to supporting local industry and Ohio's habitat.
